A Vespoid helmet. The carapace
material is susceptible to fire
but offers sturdy coverage.
ar:744512064:head.name: Vespoid Helm β

ar:744512064:legs.description:
Leg armor made from Vespoid
parts. Ingenious artisanship has
further reinforced the carapace.
ar:744512064:legs.name: Vespoid Greaves β

ar:744512064:waist.description:
Vespoid waistgear. The design
arose from the study of highly
defensive exoskeletons.
ar:744512064:waist.name: Vespoid Coil β

ar:790327424:head.description:
Spectacles made from Bulaqchi
parts. The hottest new design
for the stylish hunter.
ar:790327424:head.name: Bulaqchi Specs β

ar:7:arms.description:
Armguards crafted from quality
ore. Every element is streamlined
for maximum utility.
ar:7:arms.name: Alloy Vambraces

ar:7:chest.description:
Chest armor crafted from
quality ore. Made with a
logical, no-frills construction
that puts mobility first.
ar:7:chest.name: Alloy Mail

ar:7:head.description:
A helmet crafted from quality
ore. While it doesn't look like
much, this is highly functional
armor.
ar:7:head.name: Alloy Helm

ar:7:legs.description:
Leg armor crafted from quality
ore. What it lacks in charm it
more than makes up in defense.
ar:7:legs.name: Alloy Greaves

ar:7:waist.description:
Waistgear crafted from quality
ore. The complexly shaded patina
and sleek design are quite
stunning.
ar:7:waist.name: Alloy Coil

ar:808936256:arms.description:
Armor drenched in the stench
of decay and a sensation as if
the god of death resides within.
ar:808936256:arms.name: Death Stench Grip α

ar:808936256:chest.description:
Armor said to bring death.
Unworldly light and
penetratingly cold.
ar:808936256:chest.name: Death Stench Muscle α

ar:808936256:head.description:
Accursed armor, said to bring
death. The wearer hears echoes
of their victim's death throes.
ar:808936256:head.name: Death Stench Brain α

ar:808936256:legs.description:
Modeled on the god of death.
Hearing the black footsteps
means your time has come.
ar:808936256:legs.name: Death Stench Heel α

ar:808936256:waist.description:
This gear gives off a stench of
decay, as though death's aroma
permeates the air around you...
ar:808936256:waist.name: Death Stench Bowels α

ar:8248:arms.description:
Flamefete Ticket armguards.
They're imbued with blessed fire
to be raised up in the midsummer
heat, illuminating the people.
ar:8248:arms.name: Afi Armguards α

ar:8248:chest.description:
Flamefete Ticket chest armor.
It's adorned with fiery designs
that stand out in the midsummer
heat, enlivening the festivities.
ar:8248:chest.name: Afi Top α

ar:8248:head.description:
Flamefete Ticket headgear. Its
flames dance in the midsummer
heat, flames rising ever higher.
ar:8248:head.name: Afi Crown α

ar:8248:legs.description:
Flamefete Ticket leg armor. They
dance breezily in the midsummer
heat, sending prayers with every
step and twirl.
ar:8248:legs.name: Afi Sandals α

ar:8248:waist.description:
Flamefete Ticket waistgear. Its
strikingly vibrant colors flutter in
the midsummer heat, painting
the wind.
ar:8248:waist.name: Afi Wrap α

ar:8691:chest.description:
A jacket harboring Gemma's
adventurous spirit. Wearing it
serves as a gentle reminder that
she'll always have your back.
ar:8691:chest.name: Hawkheart Jacket α

ar:884421248:arms.description:
Doshaguma armguards. Teeming
with such feral power, they
had to be restrained with
metal bracers.
ar:884421248:arms.name: Doshaguma Braces α

ar:884421248:chest.description:
Doshaguma chest armor. The
lush shocks of fur function as
a robust defensive layer.
ar:884421248:chest.name: Doshaguma Mail α

ar:884421248:head.description:
Head armor made from Doshaguma
parts. Pity any enemy who dares
scoff at its imposing crest.
ar:884421248:head.name: Doshaguma Helm α

ar:884421248:legs.description:
Doshaguma leg armor. Whether
dune or sandstorm, nothing can
slow its wearer's progress.
ar:884421248:legs.name: Doshaguma Greaves α

ar:884421248:waist.description:
Waistgear made from Doshaguma
parts. Nothing can muss the
thick pile of this sturdy sash.
ar:884421248:waist.name: Doshaguma Coil α

ar:889233792:arms.description:
Armguards designed for seasoned
hunters. Highly utile, with extra
consideration given to mobility.
ar:889233792:arms.name: Battle Vambraces α

ar:889233792:chest.description:
Chest armor designed for seasoned
hunters. Stylish, useful, and solid
protection—it checks all the boxes.
ar:889233792:chest.name: Battle Mail α

ar:889233792:head.description:
Head armor designed for seasoned
hunters. They say it must be
earned, so novices dare not wear
it.
ar:889233792:head.name: Battle Helm α

ar:889233792:legs.description:
Leg armor designed for seasoned
hunters. No compromises were
made for this sought-after
masterpiece.
ar:889233792:legs.name: Battle Greaves α

ar:889233792:waist.description:
Waistgear designed for seasoned
hunters. The striking design offers
a light, functional build.
ar:889233792:waist.name: Battle Coil α

ar:8912:arms.description:
Purr-fectly replicated Palico paws
that allow you to wield both your
weapon and the power of
unbearable cuteness at once.
ar:8912:arms.name: Toe Bean Mittens α

ar:8:arms.description:
Armguards fashioned from
lustrous, golden ore. A union
of artistry and utility with
no absence of durability.
ar:8:arms.name: Ingot Vambraces

ar:8:chest.description:
Chest armor crafted from
brilliant golden ore. Its color and
design are both highly pleasing.
ar:8:chest.name: Ingot Mail

ar:8:head.description:
Head armor fashioned from
lustrous, golden ore. Regal
protection with a crown to
complete the look.
ar:8:head.name: Ingot Helm

ar:8:legs.description:
Leg armor fashioned from lustrous,
golden ore. Clever smithing makes
the metal feel fluid and light.
ar:8:legs.name: Ingot Greaves

ar:8:waist.description:
Waistgear fashioned from lustrous,
golden ore. It joins haute design
with the very latest in armor craft.
ar:8:waist.name: Ingot Coil

ar:939921856:arms.description:
Armor to fulfill the ambitions
of those who dreamed of wielding
the power to rule over bug-kind.
ar:939921856:arms.name: King Beetle Brachia α

ar:939921856:chest.description:
Chest armor so tough it's hard
to believe that it's made from
insect parts.
ar:939921856:chest.name: King Beetle Thorax α

ar:939921856:head.description:
Armor to fulfill the ambitions
of those who dreamed of wielding
the power to rule over bugdom.
ar:939921856:head.name: King Beetle Vertex α

ar:939921856:legs.description:
Armor so perfect that one could
get tread upon by a wyvern and
not even flinch.
ar:939921856:legs.name: King Beetle Crura α

ar:939921856:waist.description:
Waistgear made from insect
materials. Wearers resemble
a black bullet when running.
ar:939921856:waist.name: King Beetle Elytra α

ar:939:head.description:
Refreshingly stylish glasses with
frames that don't obscure your
field of vision. Now you can look
sophisticated on and off the hunt.
ar:939:head.name: Half Rim Glasses α

ar:9442:chest.description:
A highly elastic Gelidron-shaped
backpack that grants impressive
storage capacity. Opens via
the mouth, obviously.
ar:9442:chest.name: Gelidron Backpack α

ar:9442:head.description:
A stunning replica of a Gelidron
head. If it looks like there isn't
a single thought behind those
eyes, it's because it's true.
ar:9442:head.name: Gelidron Mask α

ar:951292800:arms.description:
Armguards made from Hirabami
spoils. Wind rises at the fingertips
in warning to all adversaries.
ar:951292800:arms.name: Hirabami Vambraces β

ar:951292800:chest.description:
Chest armor made from Hirabami
spoils. The style is inspired by the
gallant warriors of a foreign land.
ar:951292800:chest.name: Hirabami Mail β

ar:951292800:head.description:
Head armor made from Hirabami
spoils. It keeps the wearer
attuned and bound to the wind
at all times.
ar:951292800:head.name: Hirabami Headdress β

ar:951292800:legs.description:
Leg armor made from Hirabami
spoils. Designed for mobility,
they feel like walking on wind.
ar:951292800:legs.name: Hirabami Greaves β

ar:951292800:waist.description:
Waistgear made from Hirabami
spoils. The elegant sash harnesses
the wind to mitigate impacts.
ar:951292800:waist.name: Hirabami Coil β

ar:955926336:arms.description:
Guardian Arkveld armguards.
Instills the desire to tear at
friend and foe alike.
ar:955926336:arms.name: G. Arkveld Vambraces β

ar:955926336:chest.description:
Guardian Arkveld chest armor.
It beckons forth a shudder of
indescribable power.
ar:955926336:chest.name: G. Arkveld Mail β

ar:955926336:head.description:
Guardian Arkveld head armor.
A host of heightened senses
make up for the narrow view.
ar:955926336:head.name: G. Arkveld Helm β

ar:955926336:legs.description:
Guardian Arkveld leg armor.
Their power grows with each
relentless, hungry step.
ar:955926336:legs.name: G. Arkveld Greaves β

ar:955926336:waist.description:
Guardian Arkveld waistgear.
The chains writhe subtly, eager
to ensnare prey.
ar:955926336:waist.name: G. Arkveld Coil β
